flux_denominator: trapezoidal integral of emitted geometric area_A2 over observable time_s
observed_event_acceptance_basis: observed desorption event counts only; propensity estimates do not pass acceptance
propensity_integral: trapezoidal integral of instantaneous total CTMC desorb-si/desorb-al propensity over the selected observable tail
propensity_interpretation: Trapezoidally integrated instantaneous total CTMC desorption propensity, converted to expected gross event-equivalent flux; not observed event release, not an observed rate, and not net dissolution.
sensitivity_statistic: same-seed paired linear deltas; reported delta_log10 is log10(arithmetic mean perturbed response) minus log10(arithmetic mean nominal response)
